info.title: Handoff CMS Authority API
info.description: Authoritative transport over @cms/core and @cms/storage. Agents propose; humans approve, publish, and roll back. Service and MCP identities never approve or publish. Canonical-written and live-propagated deploy states are distinct.

parameters.name: Accept-Language
parameters.description: Preferred peer locale. Omitted defaults to 'en'; a non-empty value without supported 'en' or 'es' language ranges returns E_BAD_LOCALE.

get.description: Returns 200 with `{ status: "ok" }` if the API process is alive. This endpoint is the only route in the authority surface that does not require an `Authorization` header or an `X-Tenant-Id` header. The response echoes the negotiated locale (`en` or `es`) so the same probe works for both peers.

post.description: Records an approval. Service and MCP identities are refused before the policy engine. post.summary: Record a host deployment receipt (coordinator-gated, adapter-owned)
post.description: Records pending, succeeded, or failed host propagation separately from the canonical write and advances the proposal deployment state. Authority: the authenticated caller must have `identity.id === adapterId` and carry the narrowly scoped provisional `deploy.receipt` capability. A dedicated adapter service may report deployment state; this is not an approve, publish, apply, or rollback authority. On `status="failed"` the publication transitions to `failed`. A proposal still at `canonical_written` remains there because @cms/core has no direct `canonical_written + propagate -> propagate_failed` edge; a proposal already at `propagating` transitions to `deploy_failed`.

post.description: Records successful reconciliation or an explicit reconciliation failure after a live receipt. Authority: the calling identity must be a current human (service and MCP identities are refused). A tighter publication-owner binding is an explicit integration blocker: the storage schema must grow a `publication_owner_actor_id` column and a corresponding `IdentityResolver.loadPublicationOwner` hook before per-publication ownership can be enforced.
